description: Implementation of the UserService interface, providing user management functionalities such as creating users, retrieving user data, updating passwords, managing roles and privileges, and handling user activation and properties within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the UserService interface, providing core user management functions such as creation, retrieval, updating, role and privilege management, password handling, and user properties within the OpenMRS platform. Incorporates transaction management, caching, and privilege checks.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the system after verifying privileges and ensuring no duplicate username exists.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User object by its user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user given a username.

methods.name: hasDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Checks whether a username or system ID is already in use.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Updates existing user information in the database.

methods.name: retireUser
methods.description: Marks a user as retired with an optional reason.

methods.name: unretireUser
methods.description: Reverses the retirement status of a user.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Fetches a list of all users.

methods.name: getAllPrivileges
methods.description: Retrieves all privileges defined in the system.

methods.name: getPrivilege
methods.description: Gets a specific privilege by name.

methods.name: purgePrivilege
methods.description: Deletes a privilege, ensuring it is not a core privilege.

methods.name: savePrivilege
methods.description: Saves a privilege to the database.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Fetches all roles.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role by its name.

methods.name: purgeRole
methods.description: Deletes a role, with checks to prevent deletion of core roles or roles with children.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Saves a role, ensuring no inheritance cycles.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes the password for the current user or specified user, with privilege verification.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword
methods.description: Updates a user's password with a hashed password and salt.

methods.name: changeQuestionAnswer
methods.description: Updates the secret question and answer for a user.

methods.name: isSecretAnswer
methods.description: Validates a user's secret answer.

methods.name: getUsersByName
methods.description: Fetches users matching given given and family names.

methods.name: getUsersByPerson
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific person.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users based on name, roles, and retirement status, with support for pagination.

methods.name: setUserProperty
methods.description: Sets a custom property for a user.

methods.name: removeUserProperty
methods.description: Removes a custom property from a user.

methods.name: generateSystemId
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID using the Luhn algorithm.

methods.name: purgeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from the system.

methods.name: getPrivilegeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a privilege by UUID.

methods.name: getRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a role by UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a user by UUID.

methods.name: getCountOfUsers
methods.description: Counts users matching specific criteria.

methods.name: getUserByUsernameOrEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user by username or email.

methods.name: getUserByActivationKey
methods.description: Retrieves user if a valid activation key is provided.

methods.name: setUserActivationKey
methods.description: Generates and assigns an activation key for password reset.

methods.name: changePasswordUsingActivationKey
methods.description: Changes a user’s password if the activation key is valid.

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last login time for a user.
